entries.name: MC6845 CRTC
entries.description: CRT controller that generates the timing of a character display: the totals, the sync positions, the cursor and the start address, held in registers reached through an index.
entries.behaviour: The address register selects one of the registers and a second port reads or writes it. Most registers are write only.
